haloed-eagle-head-with-pale-blue-wings.description: The eagle of John from the canon table, a pale blue-grey eagle head in profile facing left with a hooked beak and a brown breast, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two pale blue wings with mauve tips spread to either side and droop below the halo. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
haloed-eagle-head-with-pale-blue-wings.quality: Cut straight along the bottom where the canon table's sill covered the body; the wing tips are worn to the parchment.
haloed-eagle-head-with-pale-blue-wings.title: Winged eagle head, symbol of John
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

haloed-frontal-lion-head-with-pale-gold-.description: The lion of Mark from the canon table, a frontal tan lion face with a curling orange mane, round eyes and a small muzzle, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two pale yellow-green wings spread upward to either side with white and green feather strokes. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
haloed-frontal-lion-head-with-pale-gold-.quality: Cut straight along the bottom where the canon table's sill covered the body; the wing edges are worn to the parchment.
haloed-frontal-lion-head-with-pale-gold-.title: Winged lion head, symbol of Mark
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

haloed-frontal-ox-head-with-rose-wings.description: The ox of Luke from the canon table, a frontal pale yellow ox head with two short gold horns, flared ears, dark brows and a long muzzle, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two dusty rose-mauve wings spread to either side and droop below the halo. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
haloed-frontal-ox-head-with-rose-wings.quality: Cut straight along the bottom where the canon table's sill covered the body; the wing tips are worn to the parchment.
haloed-frontal-ox-head-with-rose-wings.title: Winged ox head, symbol of Luke
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

haloed-human-head-with-gold-wings.description: The man of Matthew from the canon table, a rose-pink head turned three-quarter to the right with the eyes looking right, blond hair, and the top of a pink tunic at the neck, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two gold wings with white feather strokes rise and spread to either side. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
haloed-human-head-with-gold-wings.quality: Cut straight along the bottom where the canon table's sill covered the body.
haloed-human-head-with-gold-wings.title: Winged man's head, symbol of Matthew
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

matthew-writing-at-lectern.description: The Evangelist Matthew sits on a gold bench with a blue cushion, turned to the right, his head raised and eyes looking up. He wears a pale blue tunic under a mauve-red mantle, holds a pen in his left hand over a gold lectern on a blue-grey stand and raises a pale knife in his right, with a red book with an orange clasp under his arm. His halo is deep blue with a beaded white rim and his hair is red. His bare feet rest on a red footstool. The background is transparent.
matthew-writing-at-lectern.quality: AI-assisted extraction; the paint keeps the original crackle and small losses on the mantle and halo.
matthew-writing-at-lectern.title: Evangelist Matthew writing at his lectern
usage_notes: Complete seated figure with its furniture; on the page it sat between the columns of fixed-twisted-column-arcade-with-scalloped-arch, under winged-haloed-angel-holding-closed-book.

twisted-column-arcade.description: The architectural arcade of the Matthew portrait page, emptied of its figure. A red-brown semicircular arch with a white scalloped leaf pattern and a burnished gold inner band rests on a gold lintel painted with a row of small arches; two tall columns spiralled in red-brown and pale blue bands carry green acanthus capitals with orange leaves on blue-grey abaci and stand on orange bases over blue-grey and brown plinths. Open at the bottom. Only the paint is opaque; the inside of the arch and the surround are transparent.
twisted-column-arcade.quality: The columns lean slightly outward as painted, the bases sit at different heights, and the gold band of the arch has an unreconstructed notch at its apex where the angel's wing covered it.
twisted-column-arcade.title: Arcade with twisted columns and scalloped arch
usage_notes: Fixed picture frame, open at the bottom; scale it as a whole and place content between the columns. On the page it enclosed matthew-writing-at-lectern, with winged-haloed-angel-holding-closed-book above the lintel.
The small notch at the apex of the gold band is where the angel's wing overlapped the arch; place the angel there to cover it.

winged-haloed-angel-holding-closed-book.description: A half-length angel, the symbol of Matthew, seen to the waist with the head turned three-quarter to the left and the eyes looking left. Blond hair under a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and beaded border; a green mantle over a pale blue tunic; two long gold wings with mauve-red upper coverts spread to either side. Both hands hold a closed book with a gold cover dotted in red. Cut straight at the waist where the lintel of the arcade covered it; the background is transparent.
winged-haloed-angel-holding-closed-book.quality: Cut straight at the waist as painted behind the lintel; the figure has no lower half.
winged-haloed-angel-holding-closed-book.title: Half-length angel holding a closed book
usage_notes: Ends at the waist, so stand it on an edge or behind a band; on the page it rose above the lintel of fixed-twisted-column-arcade-with-scalloped-arch, its right wing crossing the apex of the arch.
